def: Where a job goes after it has failed or timed out more than the allowed number of attempts, so it stops cycling through the main queue.
An append-only record of each change, made durable before the change is applied, so state can be rebuilt by replaying it after a crash.
Running small jobs on idle resources while a large job waits for its reservation, but only if they will finish before the reservation starts.
Starting all processes of a job together or not at all, so a job that needs eight GPUs never holds four while waiting for the rest.
FLOPs per byte moved from memory. Above the GPU's peak FLOP/s divided by its memory bandwidth a kernel is compute-bound; below it, memory-bound (the roofline model).
Anthropic's culture interview: reflective and hypothetical questions on ethics, disagreement and AI safety, with follow-ups on how you felt. Reported as where most candidates fail.
